datasets.name: 5603f28c
queryLines:
SELECT DISTINCT
  workspace_id AS workspace_filter
FROM
  system.billing.usage
WHERE
  usage_date >= '2026-07-06' -- pricing model change
  AND billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
  AND workspace_id IS NOT NULL

datasets.name: 8ce8abd2
queryLines:
SELECT
  workspace_id,
  event_date,
  initiated_by,
  COUNT(*) AS interact_count
FROM
  system.access.assistant_events
WHERE
  event_date >= '2026-07-06' -- pricing model change
  AND (
    (
      :time_range.min IS NULL
      AND :time_range.max IS NULL
    )
    OR event_date BETWEEN CAST(:time_range.min AS DATE) AND CAST(:time_range.max AS DATE)
  )
  AND (
    array_contains(:workspace_filter, workspace_id)
    OR :workspace_filter IS NULL
  )
GROUP BY
  ALL

datasets.name: cb77fad0
queryLines:
SELECT
  workspace_id,
  usage_date,
  usage_metadata.genie.surface,
  identity_metadata.run_as User,
  SUM(usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default) Genie_Cost,
  currency_code Currency,
  SUM(usage_quantity) LLM_DBUs
FROM
  system.billing.usage usage
    JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
      ON usage.sku_name = lp.sku_name
      AND usage.cloud = lp.cloud
      AND price_start_time <= usage_start_time
      AND (
        price_end_time IS NULL
        or price_end_time >= usage_start_time
      )
WHERE
  usage_date >= '2026-07-06' -- pricing model change
  AND (
    array_contains(:interface_filter, usage_metadata.genie.surface)
    OR :interface_filter IS NULL
  )
  AND (
    (
      :time_range.min IS NULL
      AND :time_range.max IS NULL
    )
    OR usage_date BETWEEN CAST(:time_range.min AS DATE) AND CAST(:time_range.max AS DATE)
  )
  AND billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
  AND usage.sku_name != 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
  AND (
    array_contains(:workspace_filter, workspace_id)
    OR :workspace_filter IS NULL
  )
GROUP BY
  ALL

datasets.name: 5da6899e
queryLines:
SELECT
  workspace_id,
  usage.usage_date,
  identity_metadata.run_as User,
  usage_metadata.genie.surface,
  usage_metadata.genie.agent_id,
  CASE
    WHEN
      usage.sku_name != 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
    THEN
      usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default
    ELSE 0
  END AS Token_Cost,
  currency_code Currency,
  CASE
    WHEN usage.sku_name = 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN usage.usage_quantity
    ELSE 0
  END AS Allowance_DBUs,
  CASE
    WHEN usage.sku_name != 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN usage.usage_quantity
    ELSE 0
  END Paid_DBUs,
  usage.sku_name,
  usage_quantity LLM_DBUs
FROM
  system.billing.usage usage
    LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
      ON usage.sku_name = lp.sku_name
      AND usage.cloud = lp.cloud
      AND price_start_time <= usage_start_time
      AND (
        price_end_time IS NULL
        or price_end_time >= usage_start_time
      )
WHERE
  usage.usage_date >= '2026-07-06' -- pricing model change

lines:
Made by [https://www.linkedin.com/in/bigdatadude/](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bigdatadude/)

This dashboard tracks **Databricks Genie AI Assistant** usage and estimates LLM token costs across your account. It consists of the following pages:

- **Genie Free Allowance**: Tracks daily and monthly consumption of the free LLM DBU allowance per user and Genie interface. Includes current-month usage against the 150 DBU/user limit for Genie Code.
- **Genie Token Costs**: Shows paid LLM token costs by user, workspace, and interface on daily and monthly granularity.
- **Genie Interfaces**: Detailed breakdown across Genie Code, Genie Agents, and Genie One including per-surface pivot totals, top users by token cost, agent-level consumption, and daily interaction counts.

<hr>

All quantities displayed (like DBU usages and costs) are estimates, based on (effective) list prices, and may differ from actual invoiced amounts. Additional caveats apply, for example:

- Free LLM DBU usage tracking starts after 20/07/2026 due to system table limitations
- Paid LLM DBU usage tracking starts after 06/07/2026 due to system table limitations

<hr>

The following system tables are queries:

- `system.billing.usage`: For retrieving billing records to estimate Genie LLM consumption
- `system.billing.list_price`: For retrieving effective list prices to estimate costs
- `system.access.assistant_events`: For retrieving user interaction events with Genie Code

<hr>

The following filters are available:

- **Workspace ID:** Scope to one or more workspace(s)
- **Date Range**: Restrict the time window for daily and monhtly charts
- **Genie Interface**: Filter by surface `GENIE_CODE`, `GENIE_AGENTS`, or`GENIE_ONE`
